main_text.head: AUTHOR
LECTORIB. S.
main_text.p: Titulus,quem fecimus huic opellæ, videtur tibi forsan arrogans. Ne erres. Arrogantiæ dicam non scribes, consilium ubi audies meum. Recepi ante biennium plus minus, & publicè recepi, me id daturum operam ut universam philosophiam successu temporis methodicè delincarem, delineatam cum mei similibus, id est discendi cupidis communicarem. En specimen mei laboris! Præcognita nempe philosophica eâ, quam temperatam esse volui, methodo conscripta. Temperatam methodum appello, quæ maximam partem acroamatica est, ita tamen ut interdum sit exoterica. Ibi scilicet ubi respostulat [?]. Prudentiæ lex debet esse summa. Sed ita summa, ut etiam sit sub summa, quæ est sapientiæ, lege. Lex prudentiæ est summa, si respicia-mus circumstantias, locum, tempus & personas. Lex sapientiæ est summa, si ipsarum rerum accurationem inspiciamus. Utraq;

page.notes: The woodcut initial T is joined to the first word as "Titulus". The word "respostulat" is uncertain at the line end and is marked [?]. The final line "itaq;" stands alone at the right below the text and is taken as the catchword. The faint mirrored text at the upper right is show-through and is omitted. The ornamental border above the heading is not text and is omitted.
